cd /tmp && cat > design.py << 'PYEOF'
import RNA

target = "(((((....)).((((((....)))..((((.((((..(((....)))(((.((....))(((...)))((....)).)))(((....)))..)))).((((..(((....)))(((.((....))(((...)))((....)).)))(((....)))..)))).((((..(((....)))(((.((....))(((...)))((....)).)))(((....)))..)))).((((..(((....)))(((.((....))(((...)))((....)).)))(((....)))..)))).((((..(((....)))(((.((....))(((...)))((....)).)))(((....)))..)))).))))..(((....)))))).((....)))))"
n = len(target)

stack=[]
pairs={}
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pairs[j]=i; pairs[i]=j

# find hairpin loops (innermost stems closing an all-unpaired run)
loops=[]
for i in range(n):
    if target[i]=='(' and pairs[i]>i:
        j=pairs[i]
        if all(target[k]=='.' for k in range(i+1,j)):
            loops.append((i,j))

seq = ['A']*n

# tetraloop and triloop caps
tetra = "GAAA"
tri = "GAA"

# assign hairpin closing pair + loop
for (i,j) in loops:
    looplen = j-i-1
    seq[i]='C'; seq[j]='G'
    if looplen==4:
        cap = tetra
    elif looplen==3:
        cap = tri
    else:
        cap = 'A'*looplen
    for k,ch in enumerate(cap):
        seq[i+1+k]=ch

# now assign remaining paired positions with GC pairs, going from outside in isn't necessary;
# just walk all pairs, if not yet assigned, assign G-C alternating with C-G to add variety & avoid poly-G/C runs
assigned = set()
for (i,j) in loops:
    assigned.add(i); assigned.add(j)

# collect all pair tuples (i<j)
allpairs = sorted([(i,pairs[i]) for i in pairs if i<pairs[i]])

import itertools
gc_cycle = itertools.cycle(['G','C'])
cg_cycle = itertools.cycle(['C','G'])
for idx,(i,j) in enumerate(allpairs):
    if i in assigned:
        continue
    if idx % 2 == 0:
        a,b = 'G','C'
    else:
        a,b = 'C','G'
    seq[i]=a; seq[j]=b
    assigned.add(i); assigned.add(j)

# unpaired non-loop positions -> 'A' already default, maybe use 'A' throughout fine

seq = ''.join(seq)
print(seq)
print(len(seq))

fc = RNA.fold_compound(seq)
mfe_struct, mfe = fc.mfe()
print(mfe_struct)
print(mfe)
print(mfe_struct==target)

# bp distance
print("bp_dist", RNA.bp_distance(mfe_struct, target))
PYEOF

import RNA

target = "(((((....)).((((((....)))..((((.((((..(((....)))(((.((....))(((...)))((....)).)))(((....)))..)))).((((..(((....)))(((.((....))(((...)))((....)).)))(((....)))..)))).((((..(((....)))(((.((....))(((...)))((....)).)))(((....)))..)))).((((..(((....)))(((.((....))(((...)))((....)).)))(((....)))..)))).((((..(((....)))(((.((....))(((...)))((....)).)))(((....)))..)))).))))..(((....)))))).((....)))))"
n = len(target)

mod_seq = "CCGGAAAGGUUACCCUGCGAGGAGUCCCGGAUAAUCCCCUUAUGGACGCGCCCCCCGGUUACCGGC"
assert len(mod_seq) == 66

# build flanking heuristic sequence for positions 0-31 and 362-392
stack=[]
pairs={}
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pairs[j]=i; pairs[i]=j

seq = ['A']*n
loops=[]
for i in range(n):
    if target[i]=='(' and pairs[i]>i:
        j=pairs[i]
        if all(target[k]=='.' for k in range(i+1,j)):
            loops.append((i,j))

for (i,j) in loops:
    seq[i]='C'; seq[j]='G'
    ll = j-i-1
    if ll==4:
        cap='GAAA'
    elif ll==3:
        cap='GAA'
    else:
        cap='A'*ll
    for k,ch in enumerate(cap):
        seq[i+1+k]=ch

assigned=set()
for (i,j) in loops:
    assigned.add(i); assigned.add(j)

allpairs = sorted([(i,pairs[i]) for i in pairs if i<pairs[i]])
for idx,(i,j) in enumerate(allpairs):
    if i in assigned: continue
    if idx%2==0:
        a,b='G','C'
    else:
        a,b='C','G'
    seq[i]=a; seq[j]=b
    assigned.add(i); assigned.add(j)

# now overwrite positions 32:362 with 5 copies of mod_seq
for r in range(5):
    start = 32 + r*66
    seq[start:start+66] = list(mod_seq)

full = ''.join(seq)
print(len(full))
print(full)

fc = RNA.fold_compound(full)
s,e = fc.mfe()
print(s)
print(s==target)
print("bp_dist", RNA.bp_distance(s, target))
